comment: The shipped TinyALU testbench (rustdv/tinyalu_tb) on Icarus. This is the framework's own end-to-end example — the one the Interlude and chapter 40 present — and until 2026-07-29 nothing in the suite ran it: `cargo test --workspace` proved it compiled, and the claim that it passes rested on somebody running sim/run_rustdv.sh by hand. Skips without iverilog.
